reviews.text: My daughter was so nervous before her first appointment. The hygienist let her hold the little mirror and count her own teeth — she walked out grinning. We've found our dentist.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.text: I'd put off the dentist for years out of embarrassment. Dr. Kim never once made me feel judged. Got two fillings done painlessly and actually look forward to my cleanings now.
reviews.author: Daniel R.

reviews.text: Four of us go here now — me, my husband, my mom, and the kids. It's so much easier having one office that knows the whole family. They even line up our appointments back to back.
reviews.author: Carla M.
